title: The queue command never files or rewrites a task by mistake
goal: Two slips at the queue command quietly change the queue: trying out the filing command files a real task (nine stray tasks titled x in three days), and typing the status command with only a task id wipes that task's status so it vanishes from the dashboard. Both should be refused or harmless, and say what they did.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-09-23 23:02: node queue/bin/queue.mjs addjson {"title":"x"} --dry-run wrote queue/tasks/p2-normal/x-5.json (status pending), dropped by hand. Earlier ones: x.json 2026-09-23T21:34, x-2 00:14, x-3 01:31, x-4 03:00 (all created stamps, all dropped).

--- folded in from a-mistyped-status-command-stops-wiping-a-tasks-s (triage 2026-09-27) ---
Reproduced on 2026-09-23 while finishing a-walk-can-reach-a-control-that-is-plainly-on-sc.

Ran:
  node queue/bin/queue.mjs status a-walk-can-reach-a-control-that-is-plainly-on-sc
(meaning: show me this task). It printed only the id and exited 0.

queue/history.jsonl then carried:
  {"t":"2026-09-23T04:12:29.782Z","ev":"task_undefined","id":"a-walk-can-reach-a-control-that-is-plainly-on-sc","from":"done"}

and the task file had lost its status key entirely:
  python3 -c "import json;t=json.load(open(...));print(list(t.keys()))"
  -> no status in the list

Put back by running the full status done command again. The fix is in queue/bin/queue.mjs: the status verb should require its second argument, and with only an id it should print the task rather than write undefined into it. An unknown status word should be refused the same way, with the list of the ones that are allowed.
acceptance: queue.mjs addjson with --dry-run prints what it would file and writes no task
A title shorter than three words is refused with a message saying why
Dropped x, x-2, x-3, x-4 and x-5 stay dropped
Running the status command with only a task id prints that task and leaves its status exactly as it was
A task never ends up with no status field at all through the status command
The history gets no event for a command that changed nothing
